hooks.text: A moon of Saturn zaps passing spacecraft with static electricity.
Saturn's moon Hyperion carries a negative 200-volt static charge.
This moon of Saturn looks solid, but it's mostly empty.

title: Saturn's Electric Sponge Moon
description: Saturn's moon Hyperion is a bizarre, porous rubble pile that tumbles chaotically and zaps passing probes with electrons.

beats.text: A moon of Saturn zaps passing spacecraft with static electricity.

beats.text: Most moons are just solid spheres of ice.

beats.text: Saturn's moon Hyperion is a sponge, half as dense as water.

beats.text: Over 40 percent of its interior is totally empty space.
